records.name: Nora Erarep
records.biography_en: Nora Erarep booked a place with The Wrong Century Excursion. Stay in the designated century. The incident report lists chunky clock-faced paddle and rolled itinerary as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Stay in the designated century.

records.name: Pip Portalpose
records.biography_en: Pip Portalpose booked a place with The Wrong Century Excursion. I got the before and the after! The incident report lists chunky instant camera with one miniature print coming out as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I got the before and the after!

records.name: Hal Epochlag
records.biography_en: Hal Epochlag booked a place with The Wrong Century Excursion. My body thinks it's Thursday BC. The incident report lists oversized hourglass neck pillow and stamped passport as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: My body thinks it's Thursday BC.

records.name: Mara Mooncheap
records.biography_en: Mara Mooncheap booked a place with The Wrong Century Excursion. I was promised a moon-facing crater. The incident report lists miniature crater souvenir in a clear globe as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I was promised a moon-facing crater.
